results.snippet:
### Description

Posted: 2026-11-11
China could soon have a new way to reach Europe without relying on the Suez Canal. Iraq's massive Development Road project aims to connect the $17 billion Grand Faw Port to Turkey and Europe through a new rail and highway corridor. But could this ambitious trade route reshape global shipping and give China a strategic advantage?
